content: Youtumba mede
Nu Pol, nu Kilisto Jesu’walaŋ Aposeldi mede i youkamulat. Jesu Kilistodok nadikunakunale tiyam, adi tiŋa Bepaŋ Tubulodanikdi Aposel kwanai titiŋdok yoŋa nanindapmagumuk.
Timoti, du adi metam nadisukilitihinit hatiyamneniŋ mihine hinek, dutok pepa i youkamulat. Baŋ Bepaŋ eŋ Wapumnik Kilisto Jesu’walaŋ siloŋ tobogoŋ, be welekulema, eŋ kulemadi dukut hatuwaak.
Poldi Timoti kwanai titiŋdok niŋkiliti tuguk

Nu Masedoniya kwetneŋ wene tiŋila mede ganiŋgut unduŋ tiŋa Efeso yokwetneŋ uŋgoŋ koti tomboyoula hatiŋa me noli mede yotubufit kwanai tiŋa metam nadisukiliti talik moiniŋ yenindidimeiŋ u yenihep tubune wabi tineeŋ.

Adi yadi kahat fifit yoŋa me bebet indigoŋ mintaaŋ hatitalabugiŋ diniŋ kahat kweheyehi be hebethik kweheyehi yoiŋ iŋgoŋ yofifile tiŋa moŋ kaŋ tosiwe hati-tiiŋ. Unduŋ tiŋa Bepaŋ’walaŋ siloŋ tobogoŋ diniŋ hebet nadisukiliti gineŋ hatak u uyakut tiŋa kiyokiyo hati-tiiŋ.
Ala du yadi kwanai indiŋ titiŋdok ganilat: Metam yehitubu-lodaune nadisukiliti folooŋ hinek tiŋa welehik walaniŋ hatiŋa yomnit mokit tiŋila nohiye yabukahile hinek tiyaneeŋ.
Iŋgoŋ mebop noli adi titiŋ momooŋ i bikabuŋa mede folooŋnit mokit tubumintagiŋ uŋak kamehatiiŋ.
Unduŋ tiŋa nehitok indiŋ yoiŋ, “Indi adi Moses’walaŋ Yodoko Mede hinale.” Unduŋ yoŋa medehik gigine tiŋa yohautaiŋ iŋgoŋ mebiŋiŋ u nehi mu nadidakaleeŋ hogok yofit hati tiiŋ.
Yodoko Mede adi metam titiŋ hogohi tiiŋ aditok
Indi Yodoko Mededok indiŋ nadiyam. U mede kedem, ala mebi nadidakalehinakaaŋ moŋgo hatidok.

Mebi adi indiŋ hatak. Yodoko Mede adi metam didimehidok mu tilak. Adi indihidok: me kadakahi, wombuŋolohi, titaboloŋet titiŋ, eŋ Bepaŋ sigilulum timiŋa kadakaniŋ tihatiiŋ, eŋ welehik geŋgeŋhinit, Bepaŋ’walaŋ hatihatidok yopekit tiiŋ, mehim-behiye udihikumiiŋ, me udihikumufit tiiŋ,

metam kefifile tiiŋ, be medigoŋ me nohiyedut Sodomhi me’walaŋ titiŋ hogoli u tiiŋ, be meeniŋ kubo yanagila wooŋ nolidut muneeŋdok kibikibi tiiŋ, metam mede yalaŋ yoiŋ, eŋ Wapum wou foloŋ yokwambunda yalayalaŋ tiiŋ, tiŋa titiŋ nolidi Mede Momooŋ u mik timiiŋ. Titiŋ hogohogok i kunali fomun u tiiŋ heki aditok nadiŋa Yodoko Mede u yoŋit.

Mede biyagoŋ yoŋ adi Bepaŋdi Mede Momooŋ yohautawit yoŋa naniŋguk, wendok tuwolit hinek. Mede Momooŋ wendi indiŋ ninimbihitak, Bepaŋ ne adi hatihati momooŋ diniŋ molom eŋ wougigit adi saŋiniŋnit eŋ loloŋnit hatilak.
Bepaŋdi Jesu’walaŋ kedem doktiŋa ninigitak
Wapumnik Jesu Kilisto adi saŋiniŋ namuŋa nehitubu-kilitiguk doktiŋa niutumbalat. Adigoŋ nadisukilitine kanadiune tuwot tubune kwanaiŋiŋ titiŋdok naniŋdapmaguk.

Nu koom Jesu wou nintifooŋ kayoŋbopŋiye memik tiyemiŋa widihiŋa yehitubu-figita tulugut, iŋgoŋ kibi adi momooŋ unduŋ tinamguk. Nu uŋaniŋ Wapumnik diniŋ mebiŋiŋ mu nadidakalegut tiŋa nadisukilitinenit mokit hatiŋila unduŋ tugut doktiŋa adi welekulema tinamguk.
Kaŋ Wapumnik’walaaniŋ siloŋ tobogoŋdi nu’walaŋkade fotokiune Kilisto Jesu gut galiŋa adi nadisukilitimiŋa welenedi metam noli yabukahilegut.

“Kilisto Jesu adi metam kadakaniŋ titiŋ indi nihitutumbawene kwetfoloŋ foguk.” Mede woŋ adi folooŋ hinek kuyoŋ. Wendoktiŋa metam hogohogok indi adi mede u nadisukiliti titiŋdok. Iŋgoŋ nu adi biyaku metam noli yalakapmeeŋ kadakaniŋ wapum hinek tugut

wendoktiŋa Bepaŋdi Kilisto Jesu’walaŋ welekulemaŋiŋ dapmandapmaŋnit mokit halimilak wendiniŋ mebi tubuhauta tibe nadiŋa kadakaniŋne wapum u tumolokutnamguk. Adi kadakaniŋne yabuŋa gehiŋgehiŋ mu nehikelekukuk. Adi yadi tobo kulemaŋgoŋ, eŋ baigoŋbaigoŋ tiŋa nehitubu-lodaguk. Kaŋ metam mindaŋkade hatineeŋdi nu’walaŋkade kudi mintaguk u kaŋ adi maaŋ nadisukilitimiŋa hatihati fafaŋeniŋ kahileneeŋ.

Hatihati fafaŋeniŋ diniŋ Mapme loloŋnit u nintilonim! Adi kumuŋ mu tilak, eŋ hebiniŋ hatibu mu kayam. Bepaŋ kubugoŋ hogok adi wougigit saŋiniŋnit eŋ filimpipitnit haliwooŋ halaak fafaŋeniŋ. U biyagoŋ.
Jesu’walaŋ Mede Momooŋ doktiŋa mik momooŋgoŋ titiŋdok
Timoti, mihine, koom dutok kigili mede mintaguk wendok tuwolit ganindakaleŋit, uŋakoŋ kamegamulat. Du u kamehatiŋa fafaŋeŋ Jesu’walaŋ mededok mik momooŋgoŋ tuluwaaŋ.
Tiŋa nadisukilitige fafaŋeniŋ halune walage kadokoune walaniŋ hatuwaak. Metam noli welehik maaneŋ walaniŋ hatihati u sigilulum timiŋgiŋ doktiŋa nadisukilitihik fiyakulune talik tubufikiŋ.
Adi’walaaniŋ niŋ Haimeniya eŋ noli Alesanda, ala adi nadidakale momooŋ tubumintaaŋ Bepaŋ kotigoŋ mu nintubukadakadok yoŋa Sadaŋ kohoŋ foloŋ yapmegut.
